title: Is the Open to Work Setting on LinkedIn Desperate?
description:
There's a lot of talk lately about whether or not it's desperate for job seekers to use the green "Open to Work" banner on LinkedIn.  Should you use the #OpenToWork banner? YES! It helps hiring managers & recruiters source talent and makes it clear you’re willing to have a conversation. Hiring is a long process, and convincing someone who’s happy at their job to leave is really hard—so this saves time for both parties. (Note: If you’re concerned about anyone knowing you’re looking, be careful with this setting. We can post a part 2 about how to choose who views your "open to work" settings.)
